en: Album page holding a dozen vintage postcards that show people in traditional Transylvanian Saxon and Landler costumes: wedding couples, families, groups and interiors. Most cards are sepia; one is hand‑tinted. Captions printed under the images are in German (examples include phrases like "Sächsisches Brautpaar" and "Sächsische Frau mit Mädchen"). A round stamp on the mounting sheet reads Brukenthal Museum, suggesting collection ties to Sibiu.
